lowStarReviews.title: Core features removed and hidden behind a paywall — huge downgrade
lowStarReviews.text:
I’ve used MyFitnessPal for nearly a decade and this update removed a key feature. Previously, I could see calories, carbs, fat, protein, and sodium for each food item and as a total for each meal, all in one view (especially in landscape/iPad).

Now I have to tap into each individual food and expand details just to see basic nutrients like sodium. This makes it much harder to compare foods and track nutrients efficiently.

Features like sodium tracking that were previously free are now hidden behind a paywall, which makes this update even more frustrating.

It’s also unclear whether upgrading to Premium would even restore the original functionality, and I shouldn’t have to pay to get back features that used to be included.

This is a downgrade, not an improvement. Please restore nutrient visibility in the diary and per-meal view.
